entry: CellBender 0.4.0 is on PyPI; it gets its own environment so the lab's 0.3.2 launcher stays untouched. Whether 0.4.0 still fails at the checkpoint save (the weakref error of 0.3.2) is tested on one library before all 54 are submitted.

Environment built in 20 min (59755209): cellbender 0.4.0, torch 2.15.0 with the CUDA 13.2 runtime, pyro-ppl 1.9.2, Python 3.11. Test on hgmm_1k_v3 submitted (59775078) with the plain cellbender command, not the lab launcher that works around the 0.3.2 checkpoint error.

CellBender 0.4.0 test passed: 8 min 45 s on hgmm_1k_v3 (0.3.2 took about as long), all three budget outputs written, no checkpoint error with the plain command. Only the HTML report step fails, as with 0.3.2, and is not needed. The other 53 libraries submitted with the settings 0.3.2 had (59779508).

CellBender 0.4.0 finished on all 54 libraries (53 array tasks and the test library), every one with a filtered output at budgets 0, 0.5% and 1%; no failures and no resubmission needed. The plain cellbender command of 0.4.0 saves its checkpoint, so the lab's checkpoint fix was not used.

Glymph 0.3.2 (frozen in 20261117-1342_glymph-032-dev after five development rounds; all unit and end-to-end tests pass on a compute node) submitted on all 54 libraries: four false-positive budgets and a second run of the default for the run-to-run spread, then scoring of every tool and the tables; also the four-GPU throughput run, three CPU-only runs and the four scaling runs. CellBender 0.4.0 scaling runs finished: 53 min 45 s, 1 h 56 min, 1 h 51 min and 4 h 29 min for 20,000 to 160,000 cells, with 19.8, 37.7, 54.7 and 128 GB of RAM (0.3.2: 56 min, 1 h 50 min, 1 h 46 min, 4 h 29 min; 19.5 to 112 GB). CellBender 0.4.0 per library: median 2,135 s, 34.5 GPU-hours for the 54 (0.3.2: 2,122 s, 35.2). HPC3 is reached through the office Studio (the VPN is down, Tailscale is up); helpers in code/hpc_relay.

Benchmark scored: 54 libraries, every tool, no failures. All 270 Glymph 0.3.2 tasks completed. Tables here name the tools by role (tool_names.tsv; as scored in as_scored/): glymph is 0.3.2, glymph_rep2 a second run of the same code, glymph_031 the version before, cellbender is 0.4.0 and cellbender032 is 0.3.2. Glymph 0.3.2 against CellBender 0.4.0, both at their defaults. Twelve mixtures never used in development: cross-species removal 85.7% (second run 88.4%) against 83.4%; own counts kept 98.6% (98.5%) against 99.0%; per-cell error 0.0159 (0.0168) against 0.0433; rank agreement 0.70 (0.69) against 0.54. Of these, seven 10x cell-line mixtures: removal 93.8% (93.3%) against 92.6%, error 0.008 against 0.042; four xenografts: removal 70.0% (79.0%) against 65.1%, own kept 98.0% (97.6%) against 99.3%, same-species ratio 1.22 (1.71) against 0.53, error 0.031 (0.033) against 0.046; one BD Rhapsody mixture: removal 91.6% against 92.6%, error 0.011 against 0.040. All mixtures by group: nuclei 79.6% against 32.3%; Parse 77.7% (75.6%) against 62.3%. Kidney: error 0.0892 against 0.0971, removed over truth 0.99 against 0.96, tubule markers removed 86% against 83%. Per-cell error lower on 30 of the 32 libraries with truth (not on hgmm_10k_v3 and kidney_rep3), rank agreement higher on 29.

What changed from Glymph 0.3.1 on the libraries never used in development. Cells stripped far beyond their true background (more than 10% removed and more than three times the truth plus 3 points): xeno_HSC_2 13 to 0 (second run 2), xeno_noHSC_3 9 to 0 (1), xeno_noHSC_1 3 to 1 (0), xeno_noHSC_2 7 to 7 (8; CellBender 0.4.0 has 425 there); development library xeno_HSC_3 32 to 1. Four xenografts: same-species ratio 2.01 to 1.22 (1.71), own counts kept 97.3% to 98.0% (97.6%), native loss 1.12% to 0.36% (0.81%), per-cell error 0.045 to 0.031 (0.033). Cross-species removal on them fell from 79.2% to 70.0% in the main run and stayed at 79.0% in the second. Twelve libraries: per-cell error 0.0217 to 0.0159, rank agreement 0.65 to 0.70, 10x removal 92.5% to 93.8%. Truth-free: marker counts kept in their own cluster on Parse tissue 93.7% to 98.0% (CellBender 99.5%), on the nuclei mixture 90.6% to 99.3%.

Run-to-run spread, from the two runs of 0.3.2: median difference in cross-species removal per library 0.3 points, but 21 points on xeno_HSC_2 (66.5% and 87.4%: the main run found no silent-gene estimate there and fell back to the learned values), 8 on xeno_noHSC_2, 7 on xeno_noHSC_3, 5 on parse_hgmm_sub1. On xeno_noHSC_3 the two runs removed 1.3% and 2.9% of counts (truth 1.5%). The xenograft level is still not stable. The main run is the one reported; the second is shown beside it everywhere.

CellBender 0.4.0 against 0.3.2: the same within noise (cross-species removal per library differs by 0.15 points on average, 0.6 at most; per-cell error by 0.0006), as its release notes say. Time: median 2,135 s per library against 2,122 s; 34.5 GPU-hours for the 54 against 35.2. Glymph 0.3.2: median 98 s (0.3.1: 98 s), 1.87 GPU-hours, median ratio to CellBender 0.4.0 across libraries 20.2. Scaling, 20,000 to 160,000 cells: Glymph 3 min 31 s, 4 min 57 s, 9 min 22 s, 16 min 8 s with 7.5 to 45.8 GB of RAM and at most 18.6 GB of GPU memory in tensors (the process held up to 22.5 GB of the card's 24); CellBender 0.4.0 53 min 45 s, 1 h 56 min, 1 h 51 min, 4 h 29 min with 19.8 to 128 GB of RAM. Without a GPU, 16 cores: 9 min 19 s (kidney_rep3), 21 min 35 s (hgmm_1k_v3), 37 min 30 s (hgmm_20k_v31_HT). The four-GPU throughput run is still waiting in the queue.

Deliverables rebuilt from this run's tables: figures/ here (three, each opened and checked), the overview deck (reports/Glymph_overview_dark.pptx, 27 slides: one new slide on cells stripped beyond their background, the limits slide rewritten; text-fit, naming, package, animation and validator gates pass; real-font PDF preview checked slide by slide for the changed slides), the website pages under docs/ (built locally, not deployed), the README, and the private dashboard (data file and page republished). stripped_cells.tsv added: per library and tool, cells that lost more than 10% of their counts when that is more than three times their true background plus 3 points; totals over 27 mixtures and 164,497 cells: Glymph 0.3.2 9 (second run 12), Glymph 0.3.1 73, CellBender 0.4.0 4,206, CellBender 0.3.2 4,126, scAR 9,704, DecontX with background 1,403, SoupX 6. Nothing is committed or pushed: the public repository and website still show 0.3.1. The four-GPU throughput run (59801844) is still queued; its time goes into resources_extra.tsv when it finishes. On HPC3 the development outputs take 84 GB and this run's 67 GB (30 GB of it CellBender 0.4.0); nothing was deleted.
